refnamediv.refpurpose: Configuration file for rdi-installer, rdii-networkd, and rdii-ssh-setup.service

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: The rdii-config configuration file is used by rdi-installer, rdii-networkd and rdii-ssh-setup.service to provision installation sources and targets, network interfaces and remote SSH access.

refsect1.title: Syntax
refsect1.para: The configuration file follows a simple syntax:

listitem.para: One key=value parameter is defined per line.
Empty lines are ignored.
Everything behind the comment character # is ignored.

refsect1.title: Installer Options
refsect1.para: The following options are used specifically by rdi-installer:

listitem.para: Format: HTTP URL
Specifies the URL under which the to-be-installed image can be downloaded.
Format: HTTP URL
Specifies the base URL from which raw disk images can be downloaded. The user can select from a list of images based on the SHA256SUMS file.
Format: /dev/...
Specifies the target device on which the image should be installed.
Format: String (Name)
Configures the key mapping table for the keyboard.
The key mapping is only applied when rdi-installer runs on a Linux virtual console. On a serial console or a pseudo terminal the setting is ignored and a message is written to the log file.
Format: true/false/yes/no/1/0

Starts the installation automatically, without user interaction, as soon as a valid rdii.device and installation image (rdii.url) are defined. If either the device or the image is missing or invalid, rdi-installer falls back to the normal interactive menu.
Format: manual/reboot/poweroff

Controls what happens after an automatic installation (rdii.autoinstall) finishes. manual (the default) shows the normal post-installation menu; reboot and poweroff reboot or power off the machine directly. If that command fails, or the installation itself fails, rdi-installer falls back to the normal interactive menu.
Format: true/false/yes/no/1/0
Only takes effect if rdii.autoinstall is true; otherwise the default (true) always applies.

Default: true. Informational popups are always shown. If set to false and rdii.autoinstall.popup_timeout is greater than 0, the popup is automatically dismissed after that many seconds instead of waiting for a keypress.
Format: true/false/yes/no/1/0
Only takes effect if rdii.autoinstall is true; otherwise the default (true) always applies.

Default: true. Warning popups that ask for confirmation are always shown. If set to false and rdii.autoinstall.popup_timeout is greater than 0, the popup is automatically dismissed after that many seconds and treated as if it had been answered with YES, instead of waiting for a keypress.
Format: true/false/yes/no/1/0
Only takes effect if rdii.autoinstall is true; otherwise the default (true) always applies.

Default: true. Error popups are always shown. If set to false and rdii.autoinstall.popup_timeout is greater than 0, the popup is automatically dismissed after that many seconds instead of waiting for a keypress.
Format: integer (seconds)
Only takes effect if rdii.autoinstall is true; otherwise the default (0) always applies.

Default: 0. Number of seconds after which a popup is automatically dismissed, but only for popups whose corresponding rdii.autoinstall.confirm_infos, rdii.autoinstall.confirm_warnings or rdii.autoinstall.confirm_errors setting is false. Popups that still require confirmation always wait indefinitely for a keypress, regardless of this setting. A value of 0 disables the automatic dismissal.

refsect1.title: Network Configuration Options
refsect1.para: Network settings are processed by rdii-networkd to generate transient configuration files for systemd-networkd8.

listitem.para: Dracut-style network option to configure IP addresses and interfaces.
Dracut-style network option to specify DNS servers.
Dracut-style network option to manage peer DNS settings.
Dracut-style network option to configure static routing.
Dracut-style network option to configure VLANs.
openSUSE linuxrc style option to configure DHCP and static network interfaces.

refsect1.title: SSH Configuration Options
refsect1.para: SSH settings are processed dynamically at boot by rdii-ssh-setup.service.

listitem.para: Format: 0/1
Enables and starts the sshd service immediately during the boot process.
Format: Base64 Encoded
Decodes the provided Base64 string and appends the resulting SSH public key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys. This is recommended for secure access.
Format: Plaintext

Sets the system's root password to the provided string and modifies the SSH daemon configuration to set PermitRootLogin yes. Warning: Passing plaintext passwords via the kernel command line or config file can be highly insecure, as it may be read by local users inspecting /proc/cmdline or system logs.
